pages.name: block.engineered_computation.era5_drive
pages.text: Cell slots: 2$(br2)Wrench the front of the middle casing on the bottom row to form.

pages.title: Built-in Terminal
pages.text: This drive has its own terminal. Right-click its screen or keyboard to browse the network's storage.$(br2)Right-click any other part of the drive to access its cells.

pages.title: Storage Bay
pages.text: The drawers under this drive's desk are a storage bay with nine slots. Right-click the drawers to open it.
